name: Pops
long_description:
Pops lets people play, remix, and share AI games with friends.

Discover an infinite feed of games, challenges, quizzes, and other fun interactive experiences made by others. Every play instantly becomes a funny gameplay/reaction video you can send to friends, post online, or use to challenge someone to beat your score.

For creators, Pops makes it easier than ever to bring ideas to life and get them played. Instead of learning complex game engines, writing code, or fighting for distribution, anyone can create or remix a playable game in seconds. Bring your ideas, and Pops brings the audience.
one_liner: Create & play AI games with friends

launches.title: Pops - AI games with real friends
launches.tagline: Turn any idea into a fun mini game to remix, share, and play with friends.
launches.body:
Hi everyone, I’m [Alon](https://x.com/alonzuman), founder of [Pops.](https://pops.fyi/)

Pops is the future of entertainment: AI-native, playful social experiences and games anyone can create, remix, and play with their friends. **Short-form software.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101541&key=user_uploads/964621/77b75800-d1a4-4c0d-a32b-d2662e68f1fd)

With Pops, you can describe (almost) any idea you have and turn it into a fun, playable experience: a Flappy Bird-like game where you flap by raising your arms, a game where you blink to screw the bolt, or a 3D racing game controlled by your head movements. You don't need to code, just a fun idea.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101541&key=user_uploads/964621/2a9308df-5961-4bd1-9571-b1518bf8020d)

And because Pops is meant to be social, every Pop you play instantly creates a video you can share. Usually the best part is not just the game itself, but the funny reaction video: you can brag about your score, send it back to the creator, or share it because it’s genuinely funny.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101541&key=user_uploads/964621/2fda7e52-ea0d-46a7-846b-dec64807ee4b)

## **About me**

I’ve spent the past six years building creative tools, most recently at Playground AI, where the products I worked on were used by millions of people. Pops started as something broader, but a private beta made the direction obvious: AI-native games are the perfect format for social, playful creation, and one of the first places short-form software can become mainstream.

Pops is live on iOS and Android, and I’d love for you to try it out:

<https://pops.fyi>

## Ask

Play a few Pops! Make or remix your own Pop, and share it with your friends.

I’d love feedback on what feels magical and what’s confusing.
